{"code":"def transform(grid):
    h=len(grid); w=len(grid[0])
    pts=[]
    for r,row in enumerate(grid):
        for v in row:
            if v: pts.append((r,v)); break
    pts.sort()
    if not pts: return [row[:] for row in grid]
    lines=[0]+[r for r,v in pts]
    cols=[v for r,v in pts]
    out=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    # horizontal boundaries: top in first color, marker lines in marker color, bottom in last
    for r in range(h):
        if r==0: c=cols[0]
        elif any(r==rr for rr,v in pts): c=next(v for rr,v in pts if rr==r)
        elif r==h-1: c=cols[-1]
        else: c=None
        if c is not None:
            out[r]=[c]*w
    # vertical sides; next color takes the row immediately above its horizontal line
    for r in range(h):
        if (r==0 or r==h-1 or any(r==rr for rr,v in pts)): continue
        i=0
        while i+1<len(pts) and r>pts[i+1][0]: i+=1
        c=cols[i]
        if i+1<len(pts) and r==pts[i+1][0]-1: c=cols[i+1]
        out[r][0]=out[r][-1]=c
    return out"}
